# Universal: one file resolves on Linux (the container and CI) and on Windows
# (local development) through environment markers, so there is no second
# platform-specific lock to fall out of step. Editing a pin here without
# changing pyproject.toml puts the container back out of sync with the
# declared contract -- which is exactly the drift this file exists to stop.
# tests/test_dependency_contract.py fails if the two diverge.
